modelling_choices.bearing: Bolt bearing circle and c selected within limits; k includes bearing thickness; fillet tangent to shaft and bearing.
modelling_choices.cavity: Nut through-bore has a helical internal surface; display keeps minor-diameter bore and mouth chamfers.
modelling_choices.certification: Nominal visual catalogue model, not manufacturing tolerance certification.
modelling_choices.chamfer: 30 degree outer hex chamfer. Nut mouth included angle 120 degrees. Bolt tip 45 degrees, P/2.
modelling_choices.components: Closed separate assembly components; hidden spring omitted.
modelling_choices.dimension_selection: Nominal bolt head height, max flats/nut height, nominal washer sizes; selected dimensions stored in parameters.
modelling_choices.display: Smooth nominal external-thread envelope or smooth minor-diameter internal bore; lower angular and fillet tessellation.
modelling_choices.family_note: Miniature envelope scaled from M2; thread/flats are visual selections. Nylon insert confirmed by owner. Collar wall, insert section and blue colour are visual assumptions. Separate steel body and nylon ring, small assembly clearance; no thread in undeformed nylon.
modelling_choices.markings: Supplier and property-class markings omitted because catalogue does not identify them.
modelling_choices.runout: External one-pitch fade to plain shank; full thread ends at underhead fillet.
modelling_choices.thread: Nominal ISO basic metric profile, no ISO 965 tolerance offsets. External rounded root H/6, internal P/4 crest and P/8 root flats.
modelling_choices.unspecified_geometry: Nut mouth for supplier rows without limits and flange M3/M4 thickness/rim blends are explicit visual model selections.
